response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth across multiple domains, extensive experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, and developer tooling, and a clear passion for engineering productivity through open-source contributions and workshops — but lacks explicit evidence of people management experience beyond informal mentorship and workshop leadership, and has no documented mobile platform leadership, which is a preferred qualification.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI systems, code generators)
Proven track record of creating and leading technical workshops and open-source projects
Broad technical stack expertise including mobile (iOS/Apple TV), build systems, and testing infrastructure
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management or team leadership beyond technical mentoring
Limited documentation of organizational change leadership or roadmap ownership at scale
No explicit experience with mobile platform ecosystems as a manager, only as a developer
